classification.difficultyReason: Choose addition, subtraction or equal division from each bar relationship; the hardest models require combining repeated a segments before subtracting a known part.

content.prompt: What expression is shown by the question mark in these bar models?

spec.description: An unknown whole above five equal adjoining parts labelled n.
spec.mathematics: The whole is the sum of five equal parts.
spec.answerVisibility: Retain the question mark; exclude the supplied answer.

spec.description: An unknown whole above three equal adjoining parts labelled q.
spec.mathematics: The whole is the sum of three equal parts.
spec.answerVisibility: Retain the question mark; exclude the supplied answer.

spec.description: A whole labelled x above three equal adjoining unknown parts.
spec.mathematics: Each question mark represents one third of x.
spec.answerVisibility: Retain all three question marks and the whole x; exclude the erroneous supplied answer.

answer.worked: The whole $x$ is divided into three equal parts. Each part is $x\div3=\dfrac{x}{3}$.

spec.description: An unknown whole above a left part t and a wider right part 7.
spec.answerVisibility: Retain the question mark and both given labels; exclude the supplied answer.

answer.worked: Add the two parts to obtain the whole: $t+7$.

spec.description: A whole t above a wider unknown left part and a right part 12.
spec.mathematics: The unknown remainder is the whole minus 12.
spec.answerVisibility: Retain the question mark and both given labels; exclude the supplied answer.

answer.worked: Subtract the known part $12$ from the whole $t$: $t-12$.

spec.description: A whole 30 above a narrow left part y and a wider unknown right part.
spec.mathematics: The unknown remainder is 30 minus y.
spec.answerVisibility: Retain the question mark and both given labels; exclude the supplied answer.

answer.worked: Subtract the known part $y$ from the whole $30$: $30-y$.

spec.description: Four adjoining parts a followed by a part 5, above a full-width dashed unknown region.
spec.mathematics: The unknown total is four a parts plus 5.
spec.answerVisibility: Retain the dashed unknown region and question mark; exclude the supplied answer.

spec.description: A wider part 12 followed by two equal parts a, above a full-width dashed unknown region.
spec.mathematics: The unknown total is 12 plus two a parts.
spec.answerVisibility: Retain the dashed unknown region and question mark; exclude the supplied answer.

spec.description: Three equal parts a above an aligned lower row with a dashed unknown remainder and a narrow solid right part 2.
spec.mathematics: The total is 3a; the unknown region excludes the part 2.
spec.answerVisibility: Retain the dashed remainder, question mark and given labels; exclude the supplied answer.

answer.worked: The whole is $a+a+a=3a$. Subtract the known part $2$ to obtain $3a-2$.

spec.description: Four equal parts a above an aligned lower row with a dashed unknown remainder and a narrow solid right part 6.
spec.mathematics: The total is 4a; the unknown region excludes the part 6.
spec.answerVisibility: Retain the dashed remainder, question mark and given labels; exclude the supplied answer.

answer.worked: The whole is $a+a+a+a=4a$. Subtract the known part $6$ to obtain $4a-6$.
